about.title: Fell-aɣ Podacium — Tuɣdaṭ & Tanmuɣli-nneɣ
about.description: Af amek Podacium ibeddel aselmed d umahil deg MENA. Lmed ɣef tuɣdaṭ-nneɣ i usejhed n yimusnawen s ulmad, amahil ilelli, d tesleḍt n yisefka.

pricing.title: Azal — Isurifen i Yal Amusnaw
pricing.description: Fren asurif iwulfa-k. Seg uswir baṭel alamma d win n tkebbaniyin, ldi ifecka n ulmad, amahil ilelli d BI i usifses n ugmu-inek.

contact.title: Anermis — Nella Da i Tallelt
contact.description: Nermes tarbaɛt n Podacium. Ɣas tesɛiḍ asteqsi ɣef ulmad, amahil ilelli neɣ ifecka n BI, newjed ad k-nɛiwen.

careers.title: Imahilen — Rnu ɣer Terbaɛt-nneɣ
careers.description: Ili-k d amur seg yimal n uselmed d umahil. Senqed imukan yeldin deg Podacium yerna ɛiwen-aɣ deg lebni n tenfalit i yesnernayen imusnawen deg MENA.

partners.title: Imeddukal — Tagnatin n Tddukli
partners.description: Nadi tagnatin n tddukli d Podacium. Ɣas d tasdawit, d takebbanit neɣ d tuddsa tusligt, as-d ad nexleq lqid s tdukli.

privacy.title: Tasertit n Tbaḍnit — Amek i Nḥerrez Isefka-ik
privacy.description: Issin amek i d-njemmeɛ, nseqdac, yerna nḥerrez isallen-ik udmawanen deg Podacium. Tuffɣa d tɣellist n yisefka d tizwiriwin-nneɣ timezwura.

terms.title: Tiwtilin n Useqdec — Agatu n Useqdac
terms.description: Ɣer tiwtilin d tegnatin i inebbḍen aseqdec-ik n yimeẓla n ulmad, amahil ilelli d tusnimmant n tnezzut n Podacium.

cookies.title: Tasertit n Inagan n Tuqqna — Amek i Nseqdac Inagan
cookies.description: Gzu amek Podacium iseqdac inagan n tuqqna d tatiknulujit yettemcabin i usnerni n tirmit-ik n ulmad d umahil deg tenfalit-nneɣ.

refund.title: Tasertit n Urrad — Aḍman n Tuɣalin n Tedrimt
refund.description: Issin tasertit n urrad n Podacium ɣef tmesras, ijerriḍen d yimeẓla. Numen s wansayen n ufeter yelhan yerna ifazen.

login.title: Kcem — Kcem ɣer Umiḍan-ik
login.description: Kcem ɣer umiḍan-ik n Podacium i wakken ad tawḍeḍ ɣer tmesras, isenfaren d yifecka n tesleḍt.

signup.title: Snulfu Amiḍan — Rnu ɣer Podacium Ass-a
signup.description: Snulfu amiḍan-ik baṭel deg Podacium yerna bdu almad, amahil ilelli neɣ tasleḍt n yisefka ass-a.

forgotPassword.title: Tettuḍ Awal n Uffir — Tiririt n Umiḍan
forgotPassword.description: Ales awennez n wawal-ik n uffir deg Podacium s tɣellist. Sekcem tansa-ik n e-mail i wakken ad d-tawiḍ aseɣwen n wallus.

resetPassword.title: Ales Awal n Uffir — Podacium
resetPassword.description: Snulfu awal n uffir amaynut i umiḍan-ik n Podacium.

verifyEmail.title: Senqed E-mail — Podacium
verifyEmail.description: Senqed tansa-ik n e-mail i wakken ad tkecmeḍ ɣer umiḍan-ik n Podacium yerna ad tebduḍ asikel-ik n ulmad.

resendVerification.title: Ales Aceyyeɛ n Usenqed — Podacium
resendVerification.description: Ales aceyyeɛ n useɣwen n usenqed n e-mail i umiḍan-ik n Podacium.

loginFailed.description: Tella-d tuccḍa deg unekcum ɣer umiḍan-ik. Ttxil-k ales aɛraḍ.

dashboard.title: Tafelwit n Uskasi — Axxam-ik deg Podacium
dashboard.description: Tafelwit-ik n uskasi tudmawant deg Podacium. Ḍfer asnerni n ulmad-ik, sefrek isenfaren, yerna wali tisleḍtin.

profile.title: Amaɣnu-ik — Sefrek Amiḍan-ik
profile.description: Sefrek amaɣnu-ik n Podacium, tizmar-ik, d ugalis n umahil. Smed isallen-ik d yiɣewwaren n tuffɣa.

settings.title: Iɣewwaren n Umiḍan — Isnisen
settings.description: Sebges iɣewwaren n umiḍan-ik n Podacium, isalan, d yisnisen n tbaḍnit.

notifications.title: Isalan — Irmad-ik
notifications.description: Qqim d amaynut d yisalan n Podacium. Isallen n tmesras, iznan n yisenfaren, d yilɣuten n unagraw.

billing.title: Afeter & Ijerriḍen
billing.description: Sefrek ajerred-ik n Podacium, tarrayin n uxlas, d umezruy n ufeter.

onboarding.title: Anṣuf — Sbadu Amaɣnu-ik

unauthorized.title: Anekcum Ur Yettusureg Ara — Podacium
unauthorized.description: Ur tesɛiḍ ara tasuret i unekcum ɣer usebter-a. Ttxil-k kcem s umiḍan yettusurgen.

learn.title: Lmed — Timsiros s Uselkim & Iselkinen
learn.description: Snerni amur-ik s tmesras yettwanharen sɣur imusnawen d yiselkinen yettwassnen. Issin tizmar yettusutren deg tatiknulujit, tanezzut d usnulfu.

learnCourses.title: Wali Timsiros — Issin Tizmar Timaynutin s Uselkim
learnCourses.description: Nadi timiḍiyin n tmesras sɣur imusnawen n tnezzut. Seg usnas alamma d usuneɣ, af tamsirt iwulfa-k i usnerni n umahil-ik.

learnPaths.title: Ibriden n Ulmad — Asnefli n Umahil Yettwasuddsen
learnPaths.description: Ḍfer ibriden n ulmad yettwaxtaren sɣur imusnawen. Ahilen yettwasuddsen ara k-yawin seg win yebdan alamma d amusnaw yewjden i umahil.

learnManage.title: Sefrek Timsiros — Tafelwit n Uselmad

biDashboards.title: Tifelwin n Uskasi — Tifelwin Tizuyaz n BI
